questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert when driving through intersections or turning.

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line, crosswalk, or intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if you see or hear one coming. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.explanation: When you are on a multi-lane road, make space for traffic entering from another lane. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let the other vehicle merge safely.
